target_customer: Micro, small and medium enterprises in India, such as shopkeepers and small factories, buying property and liability cover
problem: Indian MSMEs have very low insurance penetration because cover is slow, paperwork heavy and priced for large firms. Verak sold next day cover from 8 rupees a day with WhatsApp claims.
business_model: Insurance distribution commission on premiums, with data driven underwriting and pricing

founders.name: Rahul Mathur
previous_startups: BimaPe (YC backed consumer insurtech, shut down September 2021)
founders.background_notes: Founder and CEO per InsuranceDekho announcement coverage. Joined InsuranceDekho after the deal.

technical_complexity.rationale: Satellite based underwriting, ML pricing and WhatsApp claims flows are standard applied engineering with some hard parts, while the insurer partners carried the regulated risk.

defensibility.rationale: Distribution and underwriting data could compound slowly, but insurance products were carried by partner insurers and the front end was copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: InsuranceDekho acqui-hired the team in April 2023 about a month after its own 150 million dollar Series A.

market_need_then: In April 2021 India's insurance regulator introduced two standard MSME property products, and reports put MSME insurance penetration at about 5 percent. This created a regulatory push and a large underserved base.

branding.domain_note: Used verak.in per the directory entry. Domain history not found.

identity.logo: Simple letter V mark per a directory listing, single source
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and affordable, leading with a price of 8 rupees a day

rebrands.why: BimaPe was discontinued after the team judged product market fit was not met, and the company refocused on MSMEs under a new name

brand_strength.rationale: A new invented name after the BimaPe shutdown, with no found brand press beyond the acquisition coverage. The price led message was clear but there is no evidence of brand driven growth.

pivots.why: Product market fit was not being met with the consumer offering

outcome_analysis: Verak pivoted from the consumer BimaPe product to MSME insurance in September 2021 and reported 30 percent month on month premium growth by the time InsuranceDekho acqui-hired the team in April 2023. The price was not disclosed and most outlets call it an acqui-hire, which points to a soft landing for a small team that had raised well under two million dollars in confirmed funding.
notes: Company website verak.in could not be resolved (DNS error), treated as dead or redirected. Pre-seed of 545 thousand dollars appears in Seedtable and Entrackr search results. Total raised of about 1.85 million dollars on some profiles is unverified and not recorded. A 150 million dollar price on one aggregator is unverified and likely confuses InsuranceDekho's own Series A. Sources disagree on headquarters. No dated 2021 competitor sources were found in two searches, so the list is empty. Founder list on the web includes other co-founders (Vishrut B, Eashan B, Abraz M, Kunal K) from a single directory, unverified.
